description: A 30-row case study in why tumour drug kill is hard to predict from growth curves: digitised xenograft time courses, a logistic stage 1 fit per row, and a small stage 2 model judged by leave-one-drug-out against global-mean and class-mean baselines. A careful negative result: the headline model beats the mean only slightly. Code under MIT, data under CC BY 4.0.
title: Why tumour drug kill is hard to predict: a 30-row case study from xenograft growth curves
